comparison_definition.online_runs: 21_ct_joint variants, nuScenes-mini, seed 42, batch size 16, 60 epochs, launched concurrently on separate GPUs
comparison_definition.wall_ms_per_step: (last training scalar wall_time - first training scalar wall_time) / (training scalar count - 1)
comparison_definition.online_step_ms: mean of loss/ct_online_step_time_ms; includes online recursive preparation, forward, H=3 attachment and loss construction before backward/logging
comparison_definition.caveat: The measured online runs use contract 21. Contract 22 retains the same online recursive preparation and logging structure, but its exact runtime must be measured from its own event files.
comparison_definition.chart_shaping: The four reviewed rows were reselected with the exact SQLite VALUES query embedded in artifact.json. TensorBoard/Python remains the measurement source; SQLite is only the executed report-shaping layer.

code_evidence.finding: Online recursive runs use an ordered batch sampler, raw-list collate, pin_memory=false and process-local state.

Sixteen raw candidate views are converted by _process_online_raw from training_step after DataLoader collation, so the expensive state-dependent preprocessing is not executed by the four loader workers.
Full can add H=3 shadow rollout work, including CUDA synchronization and observation-only future forwards.
Online timing instrumentation synchronizes CUDA at the beginning and end of every training step.
Every loss/diagnostic value is written every step through SummaryWriter.add_scalars, producing one writer directory per metric.
